app.title: Steam Calendar
app.tagline: Upcoming game releases in a calendar grid
auth.title: Sign in with Steam
auth.desc: The app uses Steam OpenID. After signing in you get access to your library and wishlist.
auth.noSession: No session found. Sign in with Steam.
settings.title: Settings
settings.apiKey.label: Steam Web API Key
settings.apiKey.help: Get a key at steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey. Required to read your library (GetOwnedGames). Without a key, only public wishlist is available.
settings.rawg.label: RAWG API Key (optional)
settings.rawg.help: Required to resolve release dates outside Steam. Get one for free at rawg.io.
settings.calendarExport.title: Export to .ics / Google Calendar
settings.calendarExport.help: Download an .ics file or create a private token URL to add upcoming releases to Google Calendar as another calendar. Only games with an exactly known release date (year, month and day) are exported; games with no date or a year-only date are not added. The URL contains a secret token and should be kept private.
calendar.title: Release calendar
calendar.knownYear.title: Release date planned for {year} ({count})
calendar.tbd.title: Release date not announced
calendar.tbd.empty: No games with unknown release date.
error.privateProfile: Your profile is hidden from external requests. Make it public at steamcommunity.com.
error.noApiKey: Steam API Key not set. Only public wishlist is shown.
error.wishlistPartial: Steam exposes only the first 30 wishlist items publicly without authentication (shown {shown} of {total}); a Steam API key does not remove this limitation.
